title.narrative: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions through waste management in banana cultivation

description.narrative: This project promotes the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, particularly in agriculture. To this end, waste from banana cultivation is used to produce sustainable resources and products. For example, yarn, textiles, packaging material, and fertilisers can be produced from the waste. A pilot application for the production of banana fibres is being initiated in a local community. As part of workshops and training courses, members of the community, particularly women and other disadvantaged groups, are trained in fibre extraction, the development of new products, and market access. At the same time, the project raises awareness of products made from banana fibres. It creates distribution channels, including participation in a trade fair. Furthermore, it installs kiosks in hotels that sell banana fibre products to tourists.
